coverage_policy: Use only explicitly assigned raw LineIds; never fill with GT. Inspect full raw files for session closure.

split.basis: covered raw-line positions before anomaly labels
split.HDFS: fully covered blocks wholly in one interval; purge crossing sessions; no shared raw lines across splits
split.BGL: nonoverlapping 20-line windows; any-alert label; purge crossing windows

training.semantic_supervised: labelled training units only; account for anomaly labels separately

sequence.label: DeepLog-style until adapter/protocol validated
sequence.status: source inspected; not integrated or trained

contextual.status: source inspected; not integrated or trained

semantic.required: semantic word vectors plus attention-based bidirectional LSTM; supervised labels
semantic.rejected_as_exact_reproduction: logdeep robustlog is unidirectional last-state LSTM without attention
semantic.status: faithful implementation and fixed word-vector source unresolved; no silent substitution

control.status: existing validated results only; no new split fit

thresholds: Tune only on shared validation units. Choose epoch and anomaly threshold/candidate cutoff by validation; freeze before final test. Never alter splits after seeing these diagnostics.

review.main_scenario: offline commissioning: retrain after corrections, keeping detector choices fixed across strategies
review.template_only: review replaces all member strings by majority GT; no membership repair
review.grouping_aware: separate intervention requiring actual line reassignment; not equated to template review
review.warm_start_costs: 32 labelled parser candidates common to strategies; U target labels additional if used; D source labels separate
review.downstream_oracle: local intervention gains only; never summed as additive recovery

statistics: paired seeds; session-level cluster bootstrap for HDFS; contiguous time-block clusters for BGL; no line/seed IID tests; two datasets do not establish generalization
expansion_gate: alignment, functioning detector, interpretable GT-parser gap with uncertainty, and reviewable errors; all must hold
recovery: undefined if GT minus no-review metric is zero or negative; no ratio reported then
